heading: Custom roles
description: Give people extra permissions without making them a Manager.
tiersHint: Everyone has one. Managers and admins already hold every permission below, so custom roles are for employees.
rolesHint: Permissions add up: someone with two roles gets both sets. A role never takes anything away.
newRoleHint: Name it after what the people in it do. You'll pick its permissions next.
name: Name
emptyHint: Create one to hand a few permissions to employees without making them Managers.
permissionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody yet} one {# person} other {# people}}
notFound: This role doesn't exist any more.
permissionsHint: Changes apply straight away to everyone in this role.
aiScopeTitle: AI only works where the role already does
aiScopeRead: Anyone with it can ask about records, use the wiki assistant, the daily brief and the find-your-way helper — reading only what they could open themselves.
aiScopeWrite: It never edits or deletes anything on its own. Writing help (formatting wiki entries, reading CVs) only shows up in areas the person can already edit.
aiScopeGuidebooks: With "Manage guidebooks" on, that includes formatting help for wiki entries.
aiLimitHint: Leave it empty to use the workspace limit ({limit, number}). Someone with several roles gets the highest.
membersHint: Everyone here gets the permissions on this page.
managerHasAll: Manager — has all of these anyway
adminHasAll: Admin — has all of these anyway
dangerHint: Everyone in it loses its permissions straight away. People keep any other roles they have.
deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Anyone assigned this role loses its permissions immediately.
capability_manage_members_desc: Invite, suspend and edit people's accounts and roles.
capability_access_integrations_desc: Set up and look after the Clockodo connection.
capability_access_files_desc: Browse and manage the Files area that's being retired.
capability_manage_uploads_desc: Review pending uploads and their audit log.
capability_manage_announcements_desc: Create, pin, edit and delete company announcements and calendar events.
capability_manage_guidebooks_desc: Create and edit wiki entries, their attachments and highlights.
capability_manage_blog_desc: Write, edit and publish posts on advantisgroup.de/blog.
capability_manage_it_ticket_threads_desc: Start, post in and lock chat threads on IT tickets. Filing tickets stays open to everyone.
capability_view_clockodo_team_desc: Coworkers' absence types, reports and pending counts — not just your own.
capability_manage_clockodo_team_desc: Approve or deny absence requests and manage Clockodo accounts.
capability_use_ai_desc: The AI features, within the areas this person can already use. Without it, no AI buttons show and no request can start.
capability_manage_inquiries_desc: Answer, assign and close inquiries from the website's contact forms.
